label: All four repos converge on one memory store with a scope discriminator, not two stores: OpenBot formedBy/formedByBotId, openhuman per-agent identity pins, OpenGhost shared memory plus per-chat record, hermes-muse host delegation.
The smallest workable memory shape is OpenGhost's: one shared file of short records plus a per-chat record file, each record id/text/at/by, four hard limits in one constant, 213 lines, no service.
Skilled already has the skill half: sixteen skills discovered automatically from SKILL.md frontmatter plus graph-metadata.json, with no manual registration step.
Skilled's SKILL.md frontmatter is close to OpenBot's Skill record but lacks ownerId, botIds and a review state.
The written skill origin already works with no change: a hand-written SKILL.md is discovered and routed to.

The recorded-from-a-demonstration origin has no Skilled equivalent and no cheap one: it needs a browser recorder, a container per person and an external analysis service, so it belongs on the skip list.
The proposed-from-use origin maps onto a candidate SKILL.md in a proposals folder plus a needs-you item for approval, reusing existing discovery and the existing approval surface.
The spec-kit already owns the per-person continuity surface: handover.md then the _memory.continuity frontmatter block, written by generate-context.js through /speckit:save.
The mapping is asymmetric and small: skills need one frontmatter field and one folder, memory needs one file per scope and one command; neither needs a service, database, container or review UI.

OpenBot's reviewState gate is the one behaviour worth copying at small-team size, because it stops a bot's own guess becoming a fact every other bot recalls; OpenGhost's live-write posture only works single-user.
The licence position is clean for the two files worth lifting: OpenGhost's memory.js and desktop/skills.js are MIT.

direction: A separate shared-memory store and per-bot memory store
reason: No reference repo does it, and it doubles the write path for no gain.

direction: Copying OpenBot reviewState as a three-value enum with an edited state
reason: Two values carry the gate; edited is a UI affordance, not a recall rule.
It needs a recorder, a container per person and an external analysis service: the enterprise shape D3 puts on the skip list.
